description: The first READ reports '23' and the program abends without displaying a record. 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT is three-armed where the open is two-armed: app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:94 tests '00', :98 tests '10', and :101 catches everything else with MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT. '23' is neither of the first two, so the guard chain at :104 falls past IF APPL-AOK, and at :107 falls past IF APPL-EOF as well - APPL-EOF is VALUE 16 (:63) and APPL-RESULT holds 12 - reaching the error arm at :110-113. The order is fixed and is asserted here: 'ERROR READING CARDFILE', then the status image '0023', then 'ABENDING PROGRAM'. Three lines follow the start banner and the end banner at :85 is never reached, because PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM does not return.
